gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that J=ceil(1/h) does not ensure Jh=1, so the claimed unit-shift normalization and cancelled denominator are invalid on the general grid, with downstream formulas consequently misnormalized.

component_coverage.gold_component: Rational independence of lambda is insufficient to establish distinct encoded centers because the relevant coefficients may be irrational, allowing collisions and invalidating Cor:Dist.

The prediction concerns whether the scalar image is bracketed by selected neighboring nodes, whereas the gold issue concerns the invalid conversion from scalar nearest-distance to geometric center-distance and the resulting gap-level O(N^-1) error term. It does not recognize that rate obstruction.

The prediction challenges unsupported approximation rates for quadratic univariate approximators, while the gold issue is that the stated tan-based target is undefined and noncontinuous on the cube. It provides no diagnosis of the singular target.
